title: Raw pointers and references to uncounted types can't be used as class members.
summary: Only ref-counted types are allowed. clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-webkit.NoUncountedMemberChecker.

title: All uncounted types used as base classes must have a virtual destructor.
summary: clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-webkit.RefCntblBaseVirtualDtor.

title: The goal of this rule is to make sure the constructors of RetainPtr and OSObjectPtr as well as adoptNS, adoptCF, and adoptOSObject are used correctly.
summary: When creating a RetainPtr or OSObjectPtr with +1 semantics, adoptNS, adoptCF, or adoptOSObject should be used, and in +0 semantics, RetainPtr or OSObjectPtr constructor should be used. Warn otherwise. It is an experimental (alpha) checker, so the analyzer does not run it by default.

title: Raw pointers and references to uncounted types can't be captured in lambdas.
summary: Only ref-counted types are allowed. clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-webkit.UncountedLambdaCapturesChecker.
